standard_prerequisites.name: The lifting of finitely many elements of a stalk to sections over a neighbourhood, and the spreading of surjectivity on a stalk to a neighbourhood
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 1763-1768), the second by a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a map from a finite free module onto the given module over a neighbourhood.

standard_prerequisites.name: The finiteness of the kernel of a surjection from a finite free module onto a finitely presented module, and the criterion for a module of finite type whose stalk at a point vanishes to vanish on a neighbourhood
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1769-1772) as pointers to lemmas of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the kernel of the constructed map vanishes after shrinking, whence the map is an isomorphism.

core_obligations: Choose lifts: the proof lifts elements of the stalk which map to a basis of the free stalk to sections over a neighbourhood of the point (proof lines 1763-1765)
Get a surjection: after shrinking, the induced map from the finite free module onto the module is surjective, by the spreading criterion for maps of modules of finite type (proof lines 1766-1768)

Kill the kernel: by the finiteness of the kernel of a surjection onto a finitely presented module the kernel is of finite type, and since its stalk at the point vanishes it vanishes on a smaller neighbourhood, so the map is an isomorphism there (proof lines 1769-1772)
proof_roadmap: 取 s_1,…,s_r ∈ F_x 使它们在给定同构下映为 O_{X,x}^{⊕r} 的基，并取邻域 U 使它们来自 F(U) 的截面。
缩小 U 后由 lemma-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk 得 O_U^{⊕r} → F|_U 满；由 lemma-kernel-surjection-finite-free-onto-finite-presentation 其核有限型；核在 x 处的茎为零，故再缩小 U 后由 lemma-finite-type-stalk-zero 核为零，于是该映射是同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a finitely presented module whose stalk at a point is free of a given rank is free of that rank on an open neighbourhood of the point (author lemma at source lines 1753-1760, label lemma-finite-presentation-stalk-free). The proof (source lines 1762-1773) lifts a basis of the stalk to local sections, obtains a surjection from a finite free module on a neighbourhood, and concludes by showing that the kernel, which is of finite type, vanishes after shrinking because its stalk vanishes (proof lines 1763-1772). The chain of localisation steps is short but each step is applied to a specific object; the construction of the surjection from the lifted basis is the content. H2.
